🚨🚨| Jose Mourinho ‘leaves Fenerbahçe with £656,000 bill for luxury hotel stay’ — after landing £13m compensation for serving around 15 months of his 16-month deal at the club. 😳🇹🇷

The Turkish side are still paying the price for Mourinho’s exit.

[@TheSun] https://t.co/RJacHGhEKm
post.author_description: An all-round coverage of European football 🇪🇺⚽️

description.description: A medium shot of José Mourinho, a well-known professional football manager, wearing a blue blazer over a white shirt. He has short grey hair and a serious expression, pointing his index finger directly toward the camera. The background is a blurred stadium crowd with red accents.

The image shows the official logo of the Turkish sports club Fenerbahçe S.K. centered against a background of vertical navy blue and yellow stripes. The circular crest features a white border with the club's name and founding date inscribed. Inside the circle is a shield containing a yellow horizontal band over a navy base with a green oak branch, all enclosed within a red and white border.
